assumptions.statement: If a non-GOV.UK domain is flagged as a phishing site, it will cause significant operational disruption, potentially making large parts of GOV.UK inaccessible.
assumptions.quote: At worst, this could cause a major incident, making large parts of GOV.UK inaccessible.

assumptions.statement: There are currently existing non-GOV.UK domains (specifically Signon domains) that are publicly routable and in violation of the proposed policy, requiring remediation.
assumptions.quote: A number of Signon domains are currently in violation of this proposal.

warnings: dropped ungrounded assumption: "External security systems, specifically Google's Safe Browsing, actively monitor and flag non-GOV.UK domains that resemble GOV.UK sites or participate in serving GOV.UK content as phishing threats."
